result.reason: The operative revision establishes automatic 12-month renewals with a 30-day non-renewal window, satisfying the fallback position and the preferred opt-out timing. It narrowly changes only the notice period and preserves the renewal structure. It does not fully achieve the preferred position because it omits the 60-day Vendor reminder, but the stated existing CPI/3% cap in Section 8.3 is within both permitted price-increase limits.
